title: Connect marketing channels and keep skills current.
summary: Use task-specific guidance for advertising, social publishing, messaging, and measurement through your connected accounts.
highlights: Discover channel tools and their required inputs before executing a task, and use connections owned by your personal account.
Connect and manage personal channel accounts from Web Integrations or the CLI. Channel execution uses your own eligible subscription access.
Advertising and social publishing guidance covers target selection, explicit write approval, and verification of external results.
Official skills update automatically with the CLI, replacing same-name local edits and removing retired official skills while preserving unrelated skills.
Compatible updates continue the original task once; failed updates or a required new agent session stop with a clear next step.
The retired social publishing skill is replaced by channel-based social publishing guidance. Platform permissions and available account features still apply.
